features.name: Home
steps: Load a feed containing answers, posts, followed topics, followed people, and Space content (preloaded fixture)
Interact through Upvote, Follow, or Comment
Feed composition and interaction states persist
features.expected: Feed must contain answers, posts, followed topics, people, and Space content (preloaded); interactions update states; revisiting Home preserves feed composition and states.

features.name: Search Quora
steps: Receive matching topics, questions, people, or other entities
Preserve the original keyword and search context
Select another result without rebuilding the search state from scratch
features.expected: Results must cover topics, questions, people, and other entities; opening a result and returning preserves keyword and search context; selecting another result keeps the state.

features.name: Topics
steps: Open a Topic such as Finance or RMS Titanic
Load topic metadata, follower count, Read/Answer views, content feed, and Related Topics
Topic state updates across Home and Profile
features.expected: Topic metadata, follower count, views, feed, and Related Topics must load correctly; follow/unfollow updates state across Home and Profile.

features.name: Following
steps: Following shows the current followed entities
Related feed and topic/person states update across Quora
features.expected: Following list must show currently followed entities; unfollowing updates related feed and topic/person states consistently across Quora.

features.name: Related Topics
steps: Preserve follow states and navigation context
features.expected: Related topics must display and be navigable; following one updates its state; returning to the original topic preserves follow states and navigation context.

features.name: Questions for you
steps: Load questions selected from followed topics (preloaded queue)
Answer, Follow, or Pass individual questions
The queue updates without losing unrelated items
Passed questions do not reappear in the current session queue
features.expected: Queue must load from followed topics (preloaded); Answer/Follow/Pass update the queue without losing unrelated items; passed questions do not reappear in the current session.

features.name: Answer requests
steps: Answer, Follow, or ignore the request
Request state updates and the question leaves or changes state in the request queue
features.expected: Preloaded requests must appear in the queue; answering, following, or ignoring updates request state; the question leaves or changes state accordingly.

features.name: Add Question
steps: System searches for similar existing questions while typing
User either chooses an existing question or continues with a new question
Question is created and becomes navigable
features.expected: Similar-question detection must work while typing; choosing an existing question or creating a new one must result in a navigable question object.

features.name: Was your question already asked?
steps: Detect one or more similar existing questions
Present View question / Edit Question / Add new question options
User selects an existing question or explicitly creates a distinct new one
Correct question object is used downstream
features.expected: Similar questions must be detected with correct options; selecting an existing one or creating a distinct new one uses the correct question object downstream.

features.name: Question Detail
steps: Load topics, answer count, Follow state, Related questions, Request Answer controls, and existing answers
Open an answer or related question
features.expected: Topics, answer count, follow state, related questions, request controls, and answers must load correctly; opening and returning preserves the question context.

features.name: Follow
steps: Follow count and user state update
Question enters the user's followed-question relationship
features.expected: Follow state and count update immediately; the question enters the followed-question list; unfollowing updates all related states consistently.

features.name: Pass
steps: In Questions for you, select Pass on a question
Remove it from the active queue
Passed question does not immediately reappear
features.expected: Passing must remove the question from the active queue and persist the pass state; reloading does not bring it back immediately.

features.name: Request Answer
steps: Choose one or more eligible users (preloaded list)
Request relationship is recorded on the original question
features.expected: Eligible users list must load (preloaded); sending records the request relationship on the question; request state persists.

features.name: Answer
steps: Launch the answer editor with the question context and optional credential
Answer becomes attached to the question
Author Profile reflects the new answer
features.expected: Editor must open with question context and credential; posted answer attaches to the question, increments the count, and appears on the author profile.

features.name: Choose credential / Credentials & Highlights
steps: Choose an existing credential or add employment, education, or location credentials
Selected credential appears with the content
Profile credentials remain reusable in future content
features.expected: Selected credential must appear with the published content; credentials remain reusable for future content.

features.name: Upvote
steps: Upvote an answer, post, or comment
Open the same object from another page
features.expected: Vote state and count update immediately and persist across pages; removing or changing the vote recalculates the count correctly.

features.name: Comments / Reply
steps: Add a comment to an answer or post
Create a child reply linked to the correct parent
Thread structure and vote states remain intact
features.expected: Comment count updates on submit; replies link to the correct parent; thread structure and vote states remain intact after collapse, reload, or revisit.

features.name: Comments sorting / View more comments
steps: Load an initial subset under the default deterministic sorting
Preserve existing loaded comments and nested replies
Continue interaction without duplicating or losing comments
features.expected: Sorting and expansion must preserve loaded comments and nested replies; no duplication or loss during continued interaction.

features.name: Share
steps: Create a new share composer containing a reference preview to the original content
New shared post appears while preserving attribution and the original-content relation
features.expected: Share composer must include a reference preview; publishing creates a shared post preserving attribution and the original-content relation.

features.name: Bookmark
features.expected: Bookmark state persists across all visible instances; removing updates every instance consistently.

features.name: Create Post
steps: Open Create Post from Home or a Space
Compose text, image, or linked content
Post appears in the appropriate feed or Space
Author Profile and content metrics update
features.expected: Post must appear in the appropriate feed or Space; author profile and content metrics update; credential and target context apply correctly.

features.name: Edit post / Delete post / Edit log
steps: Edit content and create revision history
Post changes to a deleted state but remains recoverable through Edit log
Original content and relationship context return
features.expected: Edits create revision history; deleting moves the post to a deleted state recoverable via Edit log; restoring returns the original content and relationships.

features.name: Edit answer / Delete answer
steps: Answer disappears from normal question content
Deletion state and moderation/recovery rules are applied consistently
features.expected: Editing updates the answer; deleting removes it from normal question content; deletion and recovery rules apply consistently.

features.name: Create a Space
steps: Enter a unique Name and Brief description
features.expected: Unique name validation must work; creation redirects to the new Space; creator becomes Admin/Contributor; the initialization dashboard is available.

features.name: Admin dashboard
steps: Complete setup tasks such as Edit visuals, Add your first piece of content, Invite people, and Share your Space to feed
Progress updates as tasks are completed
features.expected: Setup tasks must display with progress; completing tasks updates progress; state persists across visits.

features.name: Space Admin tools
steps: Invite users through search or invite link (preloaded contacts)
Pending content or actions can enter Queue
Administrative actions are recorded in Admin log
features.expected: Inviting via search or link works (preloaded contacts); contributors/followers list reflects state; Queue and Settings behave as configured; admin actions are logged.

features.name: Space Posts / Add Question
steps: Create a Post or Add Question inside that Space
Content is explicitly associated with the Space
Followers receive or discover it through Space/feed contexts
Comments and Upvotes operate on the same underlying content object
features.expected: Content created inside a Space must be explicitly associated with it; comments and upvotes operate on the same underlying object.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Feed composition from user signals, inferred interests
exclusions.reason: Requires recommendation models and behavioral data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation engine"); feed structure testable with preloaded fixture

exclusions.feature:
Quora+ subscription and payments
Plan selection, checkout, payment method, renewal, entitlements
exclusions.reason: Commerce and subscription infrastructure (cf. Spotify "Premium / Billing")

exclusions.feature:
Cross-user answer requests
Real users receiving requests and their state changes
exclusions.reason: Request UI and state records testable with preloaded request list; real delivery excluded

exclusions.feature:
Cross-user Space invitations
Real invitees joining, contributor/follower growth
exclusions.reason: Admin tools and people list testable with fixture; real invitation delivery excluded

exclusions.feature:
Negative preference feedback loop
Pass persisting as recommendation signal
exclusions.reason: Pass removes question from queue; recommendation-side feedback excluded

exclusions.feature:
Recommended comment sorting
Algorithmic comment recommendation
exclusions.reason: Comment loading and expansion preserved; sorting uses deterministic rules

exclusions.feature:
Similar-question detection engine
Real-time semantic search while typing
exclusions.reason: Similar-question flow testable with fixture matching rules

exclusions.feature:
Notification real event sources
Question activity, requests, follows actually occurring
exclusions.reason: Notification states testable with preloaded notifications

exclusions.feature:
Real follower counts and topic activity
Live follower numbers, trending topics
exclusions.reason: Counts and metadata use fixture data
Credential selection and display preserved; real verification excluded

exclusions.feature:
Quora+ content paywall engine
Entitlement rules over eligible content
exclusions.reason: Subscription-gated content engine; excluded together with Quora+ subscription

exclusions.feature:
Real content assets
Real answers, posts, Spaces content
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")
